verses.pali: “Paṭicchannakammantassa, bhikkhave, dvinnaṁ gatīnaṁ aññatarā gati pāṭikaṅkhā—
verses.english: “Mendicants, one who is underhand can expect one of two destinies:

verses.pali: Appaṭicchannakammantassa, bhikkhave, dvinnaṁ gatīnaṁ aññatarā gati pāṭikaṅkhā—
verses.english: One who is aboveboard can expect one of two destinies:
as a god or a human.”
